cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: An offline maths assistant that generates mathematical explanations and Manim animation code for visual learning on low-cost laptops in connectivity-constrained classrooms.

test_prompts.prompt: Create a complete Manim Community Python scene that teaches why the derivative of f(x) = x^2 is f'(x) = 2x. Animate a secant line approaching the tangent at x = 2, label the changing rise and run, and finish by displaying the general derivative.

Create a complete Manim Community Python scene explaining the definite integral of y = x^2 from x = 0 to x = 2. Show improving Riemann-sum rectangles, transition to the shaded area under the curve, and derive the exact value 8/3.
